items.quote: And Abraham said of Sarah his wife, She is my sister
items.claim: Abraham said that Sarah, his wife, was his sister.
items.action: said of Sarah his wife, she is my sister

items.quote: and Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.
items.claim: Abimelech, king of Gerar, sent for Sarah and took her.
items.mechanism: royal seizure following Abraham's claim that Sarah was his sister
